pr_title: *: fix autoid allocation to avoid quickly exhaustion
pr_body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to TiDB! Please read TiDB's [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pingcap/community/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document **BEFORE** filing this PR.
-->

### What problem does this PR solve? <!--add issue link with summary if exists-->

In https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/13648, we try to allocate continuous row id for a single INSERT statement.

It asserts [the rows count](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/13648/files#diff-f92a6a9ee57cf92f8d63bd55d2edc05bR459) changed by a statement is known in advance, obtained through `stmtCtx.RecordRows()`.

However, that's not true.
In `insert into ... from select`, we don't know the actual rows count in advance.
`stmtCtx.RecordRows()` is accumulated in [`stmtCtx.AddRecordRows`](https://github.com/Little-Wallace/tidb/blob/f2844a1f8cfa0552050913e164fcb88bb7b4ed22/executor/insert.go#L64) in each chunk.
That means we count the rows repeatedly.

For example, `insert into ... from select` 100k rows, we assume the `rows` is known in advance and it's 100k.
However, each time the code run to `table.AddRecord`, the `rows` might be 

```
10k
20k
30k
...
80k
90k
100k
```

The total count is much more than 100k, which wastes a lot of auto-ID.

### What is changed and how it works?

I rewrite the `addRecord` function and add a reverse auto-ID hint parameter.
The caller would use the hint to guide the `table.AddRecord` to preallocate some auto-ID in the statement context.
And later use statement cached ones prior to the table's allocator.

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

 - No code

Code changes

 - Has exported function/method change

issue_context.title: Failed to commit a transaction with a large insert stmt
issue_context.body:
Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

1. What did you do?

Add the following config to enable large transaction support:
```toml
[performance]
txn-total-size-limit = 10737418240
```
Then create two tables with same schema, insert 3G data to `sbtest1`, and finally execute  `insert into sbtest2 select * from sbtest1`:
```sql
create table if not exists sbtest1 (id int(11) not null primary key, k int(11) not null, c char(120) not null default '', pad char(255) not null default '');
create table if not exists sbtest2 (id int(11) not null primary key, k int(11) not null, c char(120) not null default '', pad char(255) not null default '')
-- insert 3G data to sbtest1
insert into sbtest2 select * from sbtest1;
```

2. What did you expect to see?

(Maybe) the insertition should succeed.

3. What did you see instead?

The insert stmt failed with `Error 1467: Failed to read auto-increment value from storage engine`, due to the [`maxStep`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/0bbf1d954c85a2dc6010f4d1f412e405f2b14b02/meta/autoid/autoid.go#L52) limit ([here](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/0bbf1d954c85a2dc6010f4d1f412e405f2b14b02/meta/autoid/autoid.go#L596) the `tmpStep` won't be greater than `maxStep`).

4. What version of TiDB are you using (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)?

```
> select tidb_version();
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| tidb_version()                                                    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Release Version: v4.0.0-beta-255-gded862fbe-dirty                 |
| Git Commit Hash: ded862fbebc555de98e230ef57310f9162725a9e         |
| Git Branch: master                                                |
| UTC Build Time: 2020-03-02 12:48:26                               |
| GoVersion: go1.13.7                                               |
| Race Enabled: false                                               |
| TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306 |
| Check Table Before Drop: false                                    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
comments: @Little-Wallace  here will be a bug leading autoid exhausted quickly. last time we found it in `load data`, here in `insert select from`. PTAL, the count of handle is implicit.
The issue has been fixed by #15261 , but since #15251 set oom-action to cancel by default, we need to mention it in document of large transaction.

review_comments: Do we not need to limit the size of reserveAutoIDCount?

Unnecessary, the rows count equals to the size of a chunk https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/executor/insert_common.go#L420

@Little-Wallace
